# Third-party files in this folder

Generated by `scripts/build-vendor.mjs`.

- `material-web.js`: bundle of @material/web 2.5.0 (Apache-2.0) and lit (BSD-3-Clause).
- `qr.js`: bundle of qrcode-generator 2.0.4 (MIT).
- `icons.js`: path data from @material-symbols/svg-400 (Apache-2.0).
- `fonts/`: Roboto, Roboto Mono and Roboto Flex from Fontsource (Apache-2.0 / SIL OFL 1.1).
